source.doc_type: Reviewed condensed consolidated and separate interim financial statements 1Q2026 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (3 months to 31 March 2026 = year to date). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). Reviewed, not audited. Thousand Baht. The SCI (p.6) has consolidated and separate columns; the separate columns are used (owner decision); it prints the tax expense positive (turned negative). Note 20.1 (columns GMM 6.1 / PAA 6.2 / VFA 6.3 / total): revenue p.55, expenses p.56 printed positive (turned negative). CSM roll-forward = GMM (p.22, closing p.23) + VFA (p.37; its closing rows are labelled 31 ธันวาคม but the column header is 31 มีนาคม 2569 and the opening equals the FY2025 closing), CSM columns; new business = GMM p.25 + VFA p.39 totals. Each summed item records the GMM page. Future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment. VFA accretion is nil. RA release uses 20.1 (73,759). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. In Q1 the three-month profit or loss is the year-to-date column.
